dog.description_text:
Meet Snake! This sweet 8-month-old boy has quite a story. He and his two brothers were abandoned at a retail store before finding safety and lots of love at Bideawee. Both of his brothers have since been adopted, and now Snake is hoping it’s his turn!

Snake was born with a heart condition that affects two of his heart valves. He doesn’t currently need medication, but he’ll need ongoing veterinary monitoring, including a follow-up heart ultrasound. This adorable boy is looking for someone who will give him all the love and care he deserves.

If this animal is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
